summary: The Indian market ended the last session on a mixed note as Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into the red. Investors are currently monitoring geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and domestic banking strike threats. The market remains closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, September 21.
